name: Day of Week Finder
summary: Find the day of the week for any date — full name, ISO weekday, and day of year.
description: Pick or type a calendar date to see the weekday name, short label, ISO weekday number (Monday = 1), JavaScript getDay value, day of year, and whether the year is a leap year.

faqs.question: Which calendar does this use?
faqs.answer: Gregorian calendar dates in YYYY-MM-DD form, evaluated in UTC to avoid timezone shifts.

faqs.question: Can I find week numbers too?
faqs.answer: Use the Week Number Calculator for ISO and US week numbering.
